summary: The actual closed pair and all supplied byte/row identities reconcile. Independent full float32 Box recount supports treatment +8/+21 native hits versus the same-update-budget control. The joint target remains unmet. Mask replay, historical-frame identity, generalized efficacy and completed strict final CPU restoration are not established.
reviewed_files_semantics: Hash-bound audited inputs; all intake files byte/length verified. Named primary sources read; numeric arrays parsed/recounted. Checkpoint .pth files were only hashed, never deserialized.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset ScanRefer root Box and point-membership Mask targets; majority-superpoint GT; saved point/scene/target/order alignment verified. Model Mask reference is an inference prior, not evaluation GT. Raw ScanNet files were not independently reconstructed.

score_normalization.details: Raw Box/Mask intersection-over-union and sample-count accuracy; no performance normalization by prediction statistics. All actual native [5,1,10,2] terms, added row-loss/B budget, and total losses reconcile.

result_existence.details: Closed original controller exit0; 1230 intake files and 115854393 bytes exact; actual/canonical source/spec/import/preview identities exact; 29778 fit IDs once over 3723 steps; 9508 formal rows and final Box arrays independently recounted.

dead_code.details: Reported native metrics are called. Unused legacy DIoU helper cannot be presented as an executed result.

scope.details: One-seed development evidence, unmet joint gate, stored-Mask-only aggregation, separate historical frame, pending final strict CPU reconstruction, and preflight-only direct gradient scope.

eval_type.details: Final primary Box and point-Mask metrics compare to dataset root labels. Parent agreement, oracle coverage, and engineering witnesses are separate diagnostics.

findings.details: One seed-2027 paired run, 9508 expressions in 141 scenes. Treatment 5606/4881 versus control 5598/4860 supports observed +8/+21 Box hits only. The 5658/4850 joint gate is not met; treatment remains 52 wide hits short. No stable multi-seed, three-contribution, novelty, Nr3D/Sr3D, new initial-full, or local-holdout accuracy claim is supported.

Native point-Mask IoU scalars and aggregates reconcile, but raw predicted/GT masks were not exported for an independent full replay. Treatment Mask mIoU is lower than control (47.05625658670608 versus 47.08363994073033 percent); Mask hits change -1/+3 and all256 Box coverage -1/-4. Uniform Mask/coverage improvement is unsupported.

Same-frame 5598/4848 uncorrected Mask-reference parent differs in role from the historical 5599/4859 learned corrector. Exact point/scene/target/GT/order alignment does not establish bitwise historical prediction identity. Historical treatment delta +7/+22 is a qualified separate-forward comparison.

Both final terminal byte hashes and native formal optimizer restoration receipts reconcile. These receipts and the two-update preflight are not the later strict CPU full-state inspection of the actual 3723-step terminals. The inspection remains unexecuted at this audit boundary; source-only review cannot count as execution. Planned CPU RNG reconstruction is not historical GPU full-state identity.

Actual selected roles are 17436 matched_root and 12342 unmatched, with no matched_other cases. Source exclusion checks all original assignments and every actual role agrees, but matched_other exclusion is not empirically exercised here. Direct selected-only gradient evidence is a B8 two-update preflight witness; shared parameters can alter unselected final outputs. The treatment also deliberately adds a separate loss budget, so selection responsibility is not isolated from added supervision.

calculate_diou_3d remains defined, while its loss call is commented out. It is not an executed metric/contribution of this pair; no DIoU result is supported. The reported native Box/Mask evaluation paths are actually called and reconciled.
